contact.full_name: Fund Accounting | Trade Processing | Trade Lifecycle | Investment Operations

data.summary:
(cid:127) Finance professional with 5 years of experience in financial services and investment operations, with exposure to Fund
Accounting, NAV calculation, trade lifecycle management, reconciliation, corporate actions and investment products across Equity, Fixed Income, FX and Derivatives.
(cid:127) Hands-on experience across the end-to-end trade lifecycle: investment decision, trade execution, trade capture,
confirmation, matching, settlement, reconciliation and client reporting. Experienced in bulk trade uploads and pre-upload validations.
(cid:127) Hands-on experience investigating and resolving trade/STP breaks, including security setup gaps and missing or incorrect
Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), supporting accurate downstream processing and settlement.
(cid:127) Experience with Fund Administrator files, investment/accounting data processing, reconciliation controls and SWIFT
instructions within the trade-processing flow.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Northern Trust – Bengaluru | Analyst II | Oct 2023 – Present
(cid:127) Executed end-to-end reconciliation of income-related corporate actions, including dividends, interest payments and coupon
redemptions, ensuring accurate entitlement and portfolio records.
(cid:127) Created, maintained and deleted corporate action events and investigated discrepancies between Northern Trust records
and custody accounts.
(cid:127) Resolved reconciliation queries involving missing returns and mismatched account balances; collaborated with Data
Management, Trade Processing and Corporate Actions Valuation teams.
(cid:127) Conducted research on income announcements and supported entitlement calculations and client distributions.
(cid:127) Worked with Bloomberg, DTCC, Euroclear EasyWay, TLM, CAMA and IDC/FTS.
Northern Trust | Analyst I | Jun 2022 – May 2023
(cid:127) Handled multiple currencies including USD, GBP, AUD, NZD, MXN and INR; processed income-generating investments
including interest, bonds and dividends.
(cid:127) Prepared daily FM, DDR and unmatched reports and supported income processing, reconciliation and rate distribution.
Bandhan Bank | Business Analyst | Jun 2023 – Aug 2023
(cid:127) Gathered requirements, prepared BRDs and process flows, management reports and supported UAT.
Teleperformance / Axis Bank | Relationship Manager | May 2021 – Jun 2022
(cid:127) Handled customer interactions for financial products including credit cards, loans, insurance and investment products.
TRADE PROCESSING & FUND ACCOUNTING EXPOSURE
(cid:127) Worked hands-on across the trade lifecycle from investment decision and trade execution through trade capture,
confirmation, matching, settlement, reconciliation and client reporting.
(cid:127) Performed bulk trade uploads and pre-upload validation, checking trade records for completeness and accuracy before
system processing to reduce avoidable STP breaks.
(cid:127) Investigated trade/STP breaks arising from missing or incorrect SSI and security setup gaps, supporting accurate trade
processing and downstream settlement.
(cid:127) Worked with Fund Administrator files, extracting and reviewing investment/accounting data for downstream processing and
reconciliation.
(cid:127) Understands the Fund Accounting lifecycle: Trade Capture ﬁ Settlement ﬁ Reconciliation ﬁ Valuation ﬁ Accruals/Fees
ﬁ NAV Calculation ﬁ NAV Review ﬁ Reporting.
(cid:127) Knowledge of SWIFT instructions/transmissions and their role within the trade lifecycle.
(cid:127) Knowledge of Equity, Fixed Income, FX, Futures, Options and Swaps.
